name: GA technologies Co., Ltd.
summary: GA technologies Co., Ltd. is a real estate company operating mainly as a brokerage platform. Using its proprietary PropTech solution RENOSY, it covers the property lifecycle with information, brokerage, direct sales, design and construction, and management. It also runs Shenjumiaosuan, a digital platform for Chinese real estate investors. Dating from 2013, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
